about: The reason each company is asked for sponsorship, for scripts/messaging/draft_employer_sponsorship.py. Each entry rests on a fact in the master's lead_briefs (its source URL, read date and verbatim excerpt are printed with the draft). 'clause' completes 'I understand that <company> ...'; 'commitment' completes 'It is this commitment to ... that led me to reach out'. 'role' is how the addressee's role reads in the letter and is used only for a named person whose contact record is verified. 'fit' is the drafter's judgement of how well the fact supports a sponsorship request: strong (the company funds education), moderate (it funds community projects or education-related items) or weak (community giving without education). 'hold' entries are not drafted. Decided 2026-09-30: employers with a verified education or community-giving record may be asked for sponsorship, in the form of the user's template; other employers are not.
